evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivered the time-boxed framing ('10 to 15 minutes') or the 'quote you can depend on' promise, nor waited for a yes. Instead: 'do you have any other questions or concerns that you would like answered on this call?' — which is actually Their Agenda phrasing, asked immediately in Section 1 instead of after framing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked as: 'do you have any other questions or concerns that you would like answered on this call?' — this is correct, but it was asked before any discovery probing, so technically 'asked_before_probing' except it replaced the quid pro quo framing entirely rather than following it.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: not asked. Moving day: October 15th (stated by customer). City-to-city: 11020 Hubner Oak, San Antonio to 4114 Medical Drive, San Antonio (both local). Approximate size: '2 bedrooms roughly 700 square feet' per customer estimate (given as context, not directly asked by rep). 3 of 4 elements present.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave: 'between the minimum which is our two and a half hours to three and a half hours' — a time-based range, not a dollar anchor. No personalization to this customer's specific move (one bedroom, minimal items, standing desk, 6 boxes). Partial at best.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep mentioned '2.5 hour minimum' and '15 minute increments' — the commitment framing is there. No explicit mention of trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials. Fee transparency missing; commitment framing partial. Overall partial.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep said 'Okay, sounds good' and moved directly to next section without asking if the estimate feels fair or pausing for customer response.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No Two Promises section exists in this call; rep went straight from estimate to logistics confirmation.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked: 'I do not have any more questions for you. Unless you have any more questions for me.' — this is a throwaway format, not a genuine 'what's still concerning you?' framing.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked. No equivalent to 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep said 'I'll go ahead and send you this email' and moved to close without asking 'Would you like our help with your move?'

top_strength: Excellent detail-gathering on logistics: the rep systematically confirmed both addresses, unit numbers, floor/stair access, fragile items (standing desk, PC, monitor), arrival time constraint (2 PM), and box count estimate despite a time-pressured customer.
coaching_note: This call skipped the foundational Section 1 quid pro quo entirely and never moved into pricing, Two Promises, or an explicit ask — it functioned as a confirmation/logistics call rather than a sales call; reorient to the script flow: open with availability + time framing + promise, discover concerns, probe details, anchor and personalize an estimate, deliver the two promises, confirm the booking, and close with an explicit ask.
